systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Acoustically-Levitated Supercritical Sol-Gel Aerogel Microsphere Drying (AL-SAD) Industrial Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Non-Thermal Containerless Acoustic Supercritical Aerogel Processing Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / IUPAC Mesoporous Characterization / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & ASME B31.3 High-Pressure Process Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: Containerless phased-array ultrasonic acoustic levitation standing wave node trapping (40 kHz, 160 dB SPL) integrated with high-pressure supercritical CO2 dynamic fluid extraction (P = 110 – 180 bar, T = 38 – 45°C) across a vertical continuous-flow acoustic pressure chamber, producing monolithic ultra-porous aerogel microspheres (porosity > 96.5%, specific surface area > 720 m²/g) without capillary collapse
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Resistant to 2.0% NaOH at 80°C, Automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) & Supercritical CO2 Sterile Depressurization Conformance

aerogelFormulations.name: Silica-Alginate Hybrid Aerogel Microspheres (Gastric Enzyme & Probiotic Delivery)
aerogelFormulations.formulationDescription: Interpenetrating hybrid silica-calcium alginate aerogel network synthesized via in-situ sol-gel condensation in acoustic levitation node, followed by supercritical drying.
aerogelFormulations.precursorComposition: Sodium Alginate (1.5% w/v) + Tetraethyl Orthosilicate (TEOS, 8.0% v/v) in Ethanol-Water (70:30 v/v)
aerogelFormulations.degradingAlternative: Evaporative Ambient Drying (>88% capillary shrinkage, glass transition collapse, non-porous dense beads)
aerogelFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS 21 CFR § 184.1724 (Sodium Alginate) & 21 CFR § 172.480 (Silicon Dioxide)

aerogelFormulations.name: Cellulose Nanocrystal (CNC) / Chitosan Biodegradable Aerogel Microspheres
aerogelFormulations.formulationDescription: High-crystallinity plant CNCs crosslinked with deacetylated chitosan for nutraceutical polyphenolic delivery with targeted colonic release.
aerogelFormulations.precursorComposition: Cellulose Nanocrystals (2.0% w/v) + Chitosan (1.2% w/v) in 1.0% Acetic Acid / Ethanol solvent exchange
aerogelFormulations.degradingAlternative: Freeze Drying / Lyophilization (Ice crystal dendrite formation tears pore walls, 45% surface area reduction, 14-hour cycle)
aerogelFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000570 & USP Dietary Supplements Compendium

aerogelFormulations.name: Pure Mesoporous Silica Ultra-High Surface Area Microspheres (S_BET > 900 m²/g)
aerogelFormulations.formulationDescription: Ultra-pure tetramethyl orthosilicate (TMOS) catalyzed sol-gel for volatile aromatic compound adsorption and clean-label flavor stabilization.
aerogelFormulations.precursorComposition: TMOS (12.0% v/v) + 0.05M NH4OH base catalyst in anhydrous ethanol
aerogelFormulations.degradingAlternative: Subcritical Solvent Evaporation (Severe meniscus capillary tension P_cap > 15 MPa crushing 95% of mesopores)
aerogelFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA 21 CFR § 172.480, USP <267> Porosimetry & ISO 9277 BET Surface Area

aerogelFormulations.name: Citrus Pectin / Calcium Crosslinked Aerogel Microspheres (Hydrophobic Vitamin Matrix)
aerogelFormulations.formulationDescription: Low-methoxyl citrus pectin crosslinked with calcium divalent ions forming egg-box structural pockets for fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).
aerogelFormulations.precursorComposition: Citrus Pectin LM-104 (2.5% w/v) in deionized water followed by stepwise ethanol solvent exchange
aerogelFormulations.degradingAlternative: Hot Air Spray Drying (Thermal scorching, pectin caramelization, collapse to high-density pebble morphology)
aerogelFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA 21 CFR § 184.1588 (Pectin), JECFA & FCC Grade Standards

aerogelFormulations.name: Corn Zein Plant-Protein Oleogel / Aerogel Microspheres (Bioactive Polyphenol Delivery)
aerogelFormulations.formulationDescription: Hydrophobic maize prolamine zein structured into an aerated protein scaffold capable of reversible high-capacity oil absorption and phenolic binding.
aerogelFormulations.precursorComposition: Corn Zein (4.0% w/v) in 85% Food-Grade Ethanol solution
aerogelFormulations.gelationTrigger: Acoustic anti-solvent phase inversion by water vapor sheath
aerogelFormulations.degradingAlternative: Oven Vacuum Desiccation (Protein denaturation, disulfide crosslinking aggregation, zero internal mesoporosity)
aerogelFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS 21 CFR § 184.1984 (Zein) & USP Food Chemicals Codex
